summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Freight Technologies, Inc. reporting a secured term loan agreement of $2.5 million entered into on June 18, 2026 with an institutional lender. The loan bears 10% annual interest, matures June 17, 2027, and is secured by all assets of the borrowers. Proceeds will repay an existing credit facility. The filing is a standard debt financing disclosure with no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other special-situation event.
